description.value:
Under the skin of the pastry, which carries a slightly burnt aroma after baking, lies a soft bean paste. It isn't sweet and even has a slightly astringent taste, akin to tears.

"Stop crying, you'll become dehydrated if you cry anymore."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. Once per turn when an affected creature deals radiant damage, it deals an additional 1d4 radiant damage. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, increases Imaginary DMG of all allies by 16% for the next battle.
